copy.en:
Eight Wheels, Easy Turning
Eight double swivel wheels turn 360° for easier airport and city movement.
Aluminium handle, three height settings
PC+ABS shell, vertical texture, four protective corners
copy.zh:
八轮灵活转向
8个双排万向轮可360°转向，便于机场与城市移动。
铝合金拉杆，三挡调节
PC+ABS箱壳、竖纹与四个防撞角
copy.de:
Acht Rollen, leichtes Wenden
Acht doppelte Lenkrollen drehen sich um 360° für leichteres Bewegen in Stadt und Flughafen.
Aluminiumgriff, drei Höhenstufen
PC+ABS-Schale, vertikale Struktur, vier Schutzkanten
copy.fr:
Huit roues, virage facile
Huit doubles roulettes pivotent à 360° pour faciliter les déplacements en ville et à l’aéroport.
Poignée aluminium, trois hauteurs
Coque PC+ABS, texture verticale, quatre coins protecteurs
copy.it:
Otto ruote, svolte facili
Otto doppie ruote girevoli a 360° facilitano gli spostamenti in città e aeroporto.
Manico in alluminio, tre altezze
Scocca PC+ABS, texture verticale, quattro angoli protettivi
copy.es:
Ocho ruedas, giros fáciles
Ocho ruedas dobles giratorias 360° facilitan el desplazamiento en ciudad y aeropuertos.
Asa de aluminio, tres alturas
Carcasa de PC+ABS, textura vertical, cuatro esquinas protectoras

design_brief_zh: 主卖点为360°双排万向轮（8轮），通过“轮组结构特写+机场或城市移动场景”呈现转向事实与使用收益。PC端使用2000×2000画布：左侧文案区[x=0.05,y=0.10,w=0.38,h=0.80]，右侧产品区[x=0.49,y=0.08,w=0.46,h=0.84]；阅读顺序为标题、八轮转向及移动便利、铝合金拉杆与三挡调节、PC+ABS箱壳与结构细节。右侧以45度前侧视角展示真实箱体，完整露出8个双排轮；在底部轮组旁加入局部放大图或细线指向，清晰显示双排结构与360°转向。箱壳局部展示PC+ABS材质外观、竖条纹和四个防撞角。移动端使用1200×1200画布：上方场景与产品位于[x=0.08,y=0.05,w=0.84,h=0.53]，轮组特写保持在上方视觉中心；下方文案区位于[x=0.05,y=0.64,w=0.90,h=0.31]，按标题、支持说明、证据/细节1、证据/细节2排列。英文、德语、法语、意大利语、西班牙语均预留约20%横向扩展空间。产品采用真实Sliver、GunmetalGray或Black之一，低饱和中性色欧洲现代旅行摄影，自然侧光、柔和接触阴影，控制金属反光并保留箱壳纹理。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题最大，支持说明次之，细节行短而清晰，数字优先易读。第1行对应主卖点，第2行对应8个双排万向轮和机场/城市移动场景，第3行对应铝合金拉杆与三挡调节，第4行对应PC+ABS、竖纹和四个防撞角。资料未提供量化耐刮或耐磨测试，因此画面只展示材质、纹理和防撞角，不写防刮、耐磨、静音或适用于所有地面的结论。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的360°双排万向轮（8轮）、铝合金拉杆、三挡调节、PC+ABS箱壳、竖纹和四个防撞角事实。机场与城市移动仅作为使用场景，不延伸为所有地面适用。资料未提供防刮、耐磨或量化耐用性测试，因此不得宣称防刮、耐磨、静音、极度耐用或经过认证；不得添加竞品标识、虚构测试、评分、官方背书、额外保证或促销信息。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European modern travel photograph for a square Amazon feature module, with no rendered text, letters, logos, labels, or typography anywhere in the image. Show the real YWJ 13A travel suitcase in a 45-degree front-side view on the right, using one supplied color variant and preserving its realistic proportions, PC+ABS hard shell, vertical ribbed texture, aluminium frame and four protective corners. Make all eight wheels visible as four double-wheel units. Add a restrained airport or modern city travel context with a subtle movement path, showing the suitcase being maneuvered rather than floating. Include a clean macro inset or fine-line visual pointer near the lower wheel area to reveal the double-row construction and 360-degree swivel orientation. Add a secondary close detail of the aluminium telescopic handle with its three adjustment positions, and a small shell detail showing the vertical texture and protective corner without damage or scratch comparison. PC layout: reserve the left 38% as a clean, low-detail copy-safe area from 5% to 43% width and 10% to 90% height; place the product and visual proof in the right area from 49% to 95% width and 8% to 92% height. Mobile layout: place the product, scene, wheel inset, and handle detail in the upper 84% width and 5% to 58% height; reserve the lower 90% width from 64% to 95% height as a calm copy-safe region. Use low-saturation neutral colors, natural side light, soft contact shadows, controlled metal reflections, realistic texture, and a premium but documentary product-photography finish. Do not imply scratch resistance, quiet operation, all-terrain suitability, testing, certification, or official endorsement.
